**ROLE SUMMARY**


We are seeking a Senior Solution Architect to lead the design of scalable, secure, and cost\-effective solutions across cloud and enterprise systems. Acting as the bridge between business objectives and engineering execution, you will translate requirements into robust architecture blueprints, define technical standards, and guide delivery teams from design through production. This role combines strategic technical leadership with hands\-on depth; you will make high\-impact technology decisions, champion best practices, and ensure solutions meet demanding non\-functional requirements around performance, security, resilience, and cost.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Define end\-to\-end solution architectures that align with business goals, enterprise standards, and long\-term technology strategy.
* Translate business and functional requirements into clear technical designs, high\-level and low\-level design documents, and architecture blueprints.
* Evaluate, recommend, and select technologies, frameworks, and platforms, including build\-vs\-buy and cloud\-provider decisions.
* Design cloud\-native, microservices, event\-driven, and API\-first architectures for scalability and maintainability.
* Define and govern non\-functional requirements \- scalability, performance, availability, security, resilience, and cost optimization.
* Lead architecture and design reviews, establish coding and design standards, and drive technical governance across teams.
* Partner with product managers, business stakeholders, security, and infrastructure teams; present architecture and trade\-offs to senior leadership and clients.
* Provide hands\-on technical leadership and mentorship to development teams, unblocking complex engineering challenges.
* Build proofs\-of\-concept and prototypes to validate architectural approaches and de\-risk delivery.
* Embed security and compliance by design across the solution lifecycle.
* Champion DevOps, CI/CD, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code adoption to improve delivery speed and quality.
* Operate within Agile/Scrum delivery models, contributing to estimation, roadmap planning, and iterative delivery.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent hands\-on experience.
* 7\+ years in software engineering, including proven experience in a solution, technical, or application architect capacity.
* Demonstrated track record designing and delivering large\-scale, distributed, production systems.
* Deep, hands\-on expertise with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Strong command of microservices, API design, and enterprise integration patterns.
* A solid engineering foundation with hands\-on coding experience in one or more major languages (e.g., Java, .NET, Python, Node.js).
* Strong understanding of application/data security, DevOps practices, and system integration.
* Demonstrated experience delivering solutions in Agile and Scrum environments.
* Excellent stakeholder communication skills, including the ability to present complex technical concepts to non\-technical audiences.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS (NICE\-TO\-HAVE)**

* Experience in Data Engineering \- designing data pipelines, data lakes/warehouses, streaming, and big\-data platforms (e.g., Spark, Kafka, Snowflake, Databricks).
* Recognized architecture certifications (e.g., AWS/Azure/GCP Solutions Architect, TOGAF).
* Experience integrating enterprise platforms such as SAP, Salesforce, or similar.
* Experience with event\-driven and streaming architectures at scale.
* Domain experience in analytics, data\-intensive, or large enterprise product environments.
* Pre\-sales or consulting exposure, including solution shaping and effort estimation.

**TECHNICAL SKILLS**

* **Architecture:** Microservices, event\-driven, API\-first, domain\-driven design, integration patterns, EA frameworks (e.g., TOGAF)
* **Cloud:** AWS / Azure / GCP, serverless, containers (Kubernetes), Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform, CloudFormation)
* **Development:** Java, .NET, Python, or Node.js; REST, GraphQL, gRPC

* **Security:** IAM, OAuth 2\.0 / OIDC, encryption, zero\-trust and secure\-by\-design principles
* **DevOps \& Modelling:** CI/CD, observability, SRE practices; UML and C4 architecture modelling

description:
**Job Description: Pre\-Sales Executive – Real Estate**

**Job Title:** Pre\-Sales Executive / Pre\-Sales Consultant  
**Industry:** Real Estate  
**Department:** Pre\-Sales  
**Experience:** 1–3 years  
**Location:** Cunningham road  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Reporting To:** Sales Manager

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an enthusiastic and customer\-focused **Pre\-Sales Executive** to join our real estate sales team. The candidate will be responsible for handling inbound and outbound leads, understanding customer requirements, presenting suitable real estate projects, qualifying prospects, and scheduling site visits for the sales team.

The ideal candidate should have strong communication and interpersonal skills, a customer\-oriented approach, and an interest in the real estate industry.

Key Responsibilities

* Handle leads received through digital marketing, portals, campaigns, referrals, and other sources.
* Contact prospective customers through **phone calls, WhatsApp, email, and other communication channels**.
* Understand customer requirements such as budget, preferred location, property type, size, and investment objectives.
* Provide accurate information about projects, including:
* Location and connectivity
* Project specifications
* Amenities and facilities
* Pricing and payment plans
* Possession timelines
* Available units
* Qualify leads based on **budget, requirement, purchase timeline, and intent**.
* Conduct initial project presentations and explain key USPs to prospective customers.
* Follow up with leads regularly and maintain proper communication throughout the pre\-sales process.
* Schedule and coordinate **site visits** with qualified prospects.
* Ensure smooth handover of qualified leads to the Sales/Closing team.
* Maintain accurate lead information and follow\-up activities in the **CRM system**.
* Track lead status, follow\-ups, site visits, and conversions.
* Coordinate with the marketing and sales teams to improve lead quality and conversion.
* Meet assigned **lead qualification, site visit, and conversion targets**.
* Maintain a high standard of customer service and professional communication.

Required Skills

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong convincing and interpersonal skills.
* Good listening and customer\-handling abilities.
* Ability to understand and explain real estate projects clearly.
* Strong follow\-up and relationship\-management skills.
* Basic knowledge of CRM systems and MS Office/Google Workspace.
* Ability to work with sales targets and deadlines.
* Good negotiation and objection\-handling skills.
* Ability to manage multiple leads simultaneously.

Educational Qualification

* Bachelor's degree in **Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, or any related field** preferred.
* Candidates with relevant real estate sales/pre\-sales experience may also be considered.

**Experience**

* **1–3 years of experience** in real estate pre\-sales, telesales, inside sales, customer service, or a related field.
* Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Number of leads contacted
* Lead qualification rate
* Follow\-up effectiveness
* Number of site visits scheduled
* Site visit conversion rate
* Qualified leads handed over to Sales
* Lead\-to\-booking conversion
* CRM data accuracy
* Customer response and engagement rate

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

**The ideal candidate is:**

* Confident and target\-oriented
* Customer\-focused and professional
* Comfortable making a high volume of calls
* Persistent with follow\-ups
* Able to handle customer objections effectively
* Interested in building a career in real estate sales
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced and target\-driven environment

Compensation

**Salary:** Based on your last take home.  
**Incentives:** Performance\-based incentives linked to site visits, conversions, and/or bookings  
**Benefits:** Insurance / Travel Allowance / Other Benefits

Pay: ₹11,236\.61 \- ₹60,827\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance

Work Location: In person

title: Sr. Consultant
description:
OPENTEXT \- THE INFORMATION COMPANY
  
OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
  
  

AI\-First. Future\-Driven. Human\-Centered.
  
At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
  
  

Your Impact
  
OpenText enables the digital world as the global leader in Enterprise Information Management, both on\-cloud and off\-cloud. We embrace all things digital and are committed to being the Best Place to Work for our Employees in over 140 locations around the world.We obsess over our customers to ensure they are wildly successful in embracing the Digital World. Our customers entrust us with their most valuable information, we need to be their most trusted partner. What we do, we do well. What we create, we do purposefully to impact the world. If you believe in this and are enthusiastic about enabling the Digital World, then let OpenText turn your career vision into reality.
  
  

**What the role offers:**  

The Open Text Professional Services team is comprised of more than 3,000 consultants who function as trusted advisors, managing long\-lasting relationships with more than 100,000 customers around the world. They are responsible for the delivery of business solutions from pre\-sales to post implementation. Our teams of experts help organizations solve issues, create value, improve business performance, and work more effectively in an increasingly digital world.
  
As a Sr. Consultant at OpenText Professional Services team you will play a key role in creating and delivering strategic, impactful, and integrated digital solutions for clients using a combination of OpenText technologies. This role offers an opportunity to leverage your expertise in OpenText xECM configuration, knowledge of SAP business processes and integration to deliver seamless solutions that bridge the world of information and business application.
  
  

**What you need to succeed:**  

* Engaging with enterprise architects, business, and IT stakeholders of client to understand their business processes, technology landscape and functional requirements in order to define integrated digital solutions for their business problems.
* Planning and conducting business workshops with business and IT stakeholders of the client to elicit and document business and technical requirements for complex digital solutions.
* Architecting the OpenText solution, combining xECM functionalities\& SAP Integration, based on client’s functional and non\-functional requirements, and considering current state and future roadmap of the client.
* Creating comprehensive documentation that supports the implementation and evolution of the solution through all stages of SDLC \- Business Requirements, Functional Specification/Solution Blueprint, High\-level and Low\-level Design, Deployment and Configuration guides etc.
* Working collaboratively with program/project management team within OpenText and on\-client side to assist in task planning\& assignment for solution implementation, acceptance, and rollout.
* Collaborating with architects/developers/testers as a project team to implement the solution as per the proposed design with utmost quality.
* Assessing the current solution and impact of proposed changes to provide recommendations for release changes\& migrations.
* Basic configuration of the OpenText xECM components and Integration with SAP
* Analyzing and debugging of complex functional, design and implementation issues related to the solution and preparation of RCA. Mentoring and guiding technical architects and senior developers within the team with professional and technical advice.


**One Last thing:**  

* Graduate/Postgraduate with 5\+ years of professional experience in designing medium to complex digital enterprise solutions in area ofxECM for SAP.
* Excellent consulting skills – engagement, articulation, elicitation and influencing.
* Excellent customer\-facing skills \- stakeholder management, relationship building and negotiation – with strategic focus.
* Software configuration and programming knowledge, e.g., ABAP Programming, Data Dictionary, OOABAP, Fiori\& Development RICEF objects
* Project experience in the SAP environment, SAP HCM/SuccessFactors, SAP Hybris C4C and/or Salesforce is additional advantage.
* Prior experience in SAP S/4 HANA and Fiori/UI5 is an additional advantage.
* Excellent verbal and written communication and presentations skills
* Willingness to travel within India and globally.


OpenText's efforts to build an inclusive work environment go beyond simply complying with applicable laws. Our Employment Equity and Diversity Policy provides direction on maintaining a working environment that is inclusive of everyone, regardless of culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.
  
If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please contact us athr@opentext.com. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

title: Senior Principal Presales Sol Architect - Hybrid Cloud
description:
**What success looks like in this role:**

We are seeking a Principal Presales Solution Architect to lead the design and sales strategy for enterprise hybrid cloud managed services. This role combines deep technical architecture with commercial acumen, cost modeling expertise, and hands\-on proficiency with Gen AI tools. You will design end\-to\-end solutions integrating on\-premises datacenters with public cloud platforms (Azure/AWS), author compelling technical proposals, build financial business cases, and influence enterprise deals worth $5–$20M\+. You'll partner closely with sales, delivery, and executive leadership to win transformational opportunities and establish the foundation for successful delivery.


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Solution Architecture \& Design**

* Lead enterprise discovery and requirements\-gathering sessions to understand hybrid cloud infrastructure, operational challenges, and strategic objectives
* Design comprehensive hybrid cloud managed services solutions spanning datacenter operations, infrastructure management (compute, storage, network, security), cloud migration, workload modernization, and operational transformation
* Develop detailed solution architecture documents, technical roadmaps, and implementation playbooks that align with customer maturity levels, budgets, and timelines
* Present solutions to CXO\-level and technical audiences, translating technical capabilities into quantifiable business outcomes (cost savings, operational efficiency, risk reduction, time\-to\-value)

**Cost Modeling \& Financial Analysis**

* Develop detailed cost models and ROI analyses for hybrid cloud solutions, including infrastructure, migration, operational, licensing, and transformation costs
* Build bottom\-up cost estimates from workload assessments, capacity planning, and service delivery models
* Create financial scenarios and sensitivity analyses demonstrating value across different investment horizons and business contexts
* Use cost modeling as a consultative tool to influence solution scope, platform selection, and service delivery approach
* Validate cost assumptions with delivery and finance teams to ensure proposals are realistic, defensible, and profitable post\-signature

**Technical Proposal Development**

* Develop executive summaries, solution architecture diagrams, implementation timelines, resource plans, risk mitigation strategies, and success metrics
* Articulate how our integrated delivery model, service maturity, and methodologies address customer technical and operational requirements

title: Presales Head / Manager – Service and Solutions – Apple
description:
**Description**  



  

  

**Company Overview:**


When it comes to IT solution providers, there are a lot of choices. But when it comes to providers with innovative and differentiating end\-to\-end service offerings, there’s really only one: Zones – First Choice for IT.TM


Zones is a Global Solution Provider of end\-to\-end IT solutions with an unmatched supply chain. Positioned to be the IT partner you need, Zones, a Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) in business for over 35 years, specializes in Digital Workplace, Cloud \& Data Center, Networking, Security, and Managed/Professional/Staffing services. Operating in more than 120 countries, leveraging a robust portfolio, and utilizing the highest certification levels from key partners, including Microsoft, Apple, Cisco, Lenovo, Adobe, and more, Zones has mastered the science of building digital infrastructures that change the way business does business ensuring whatever they need, they can Consider IT Done. Follow Zones, LLC on Twitter @Zones, and LinkedIn and Facebook.

**Position Overview:**


As the Presales Head / Manager – Service and Solutions for the Apple, you will own the end\-to\-end presales strategy and the service/solutions charter for Apple offerings across the organization's customer base. You will lead a team of solutions architects and presales consultants, drive win strategies for large and complex Apple Professional and Managed Services opportunities, and ensure that solutions committed during the sales cycle are translated into well\-governed, profitable service delivery.


This is a business\-leadership role that blends presales ownership, solution design governance, Apple partner/vendor management, and oversight of the practice's service and solutions portfolio.


You will act as the primary technical and commercial escalation point for Apple\-related opportunities, represent the practice with Apple and other OEM/ISV partners, and be accountable for the practice's growth, profitability, and delivery quality metrics.

**What you’ll do as the Presales Head / Manager – Service and Solutions, Apple:**

*The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions*

* Own and lead the presales function for the Apple Practice, including RFP/RFI response strategy, solutioning, and deal governance for Professional and Managed Services opportunities.
* Build and lead a team of Apple Solutions Architects and Presales consultants; set priorities, review solutions, and mentor the team on technical and consultative selling skills.
* Define win themes, differentiated value propositions, and competitive pricing strategies for Apple services deals in partnership with sales leadership.
* Present and defend technical and commercial solutions directly to enterprise customers, procurement teams, and CXO\-level stakeholders.
* Drive proactive solution development – evaluation services, assessment services, professional services, and managed services offerings for Apple device lifecycle management.
* Own the accuracy, quality, and timeliness of all technical proposals, SoWs, effort estimation, and pricing models submitted to customers.
* Own the Apple Practice's solutions and service delivery framework, including standard offerings, delivery playbooks, and best\-practice documentation (SoPs, design documents, RACI, rollout approach, technical architectures).
* Ensure smooth transition of won deals from presales to delivery, including handover documentation, staffing plans, and governance cadence.
* Oversee lab setup and management (Apple Business Manager, Jamf, and other MDM platforms) used for solutioning, PoCs, and customer demonstrations.
* Govern service quality, SLAs, and customer satisfaction across managed services engagements; act as escalation owner for critical delivery issues.
* Lead services transition \& transformation projects, including migration of Apple services from one MDM platform to another.
* Drive continuous improvement of solution accelerators, automation, and tooling to improve delivery efficiency and margins.
* Serve as the primary point of contact with Apple's regional teams for joint go\-to\-market planning, enablement, and escalations.
* Maintain and grow relationships with Apple, JAMF, Scalefusion and other MDM/ISV partners to stay ahead of roadmap changes, licensing models, and co\-sell opportunities.
* Represent the practice in partner reviews, QBRs, and industry forums to strengthen the organization's positioning as a strategic Apple partner.

**What you will bring to the team:**

* Proven experience leading a presales, solutions, or services function within an Apple / device management practice.
* Deep understanding of Apple OS platforms (macOS, iOS, iPadOS) and associated hardware/configuration requirements.
* Hands\-on background with Apple Business Manager, JAMF, Scalefusion and other MDM tools (Microsoft Intune, Workspace ONE UEM, etc.).
* Strong knowledge of Apple auto\-enrollment, ABM, Enterprise security, zero\-touch provisioning, and APNS connectivity requirements.
* Experience designing and pricing Professional Services offerings, including effort estimation and commercial modeling.
* Experience managing partner relationships with Apple or other major OEM/ISV vendors.
* Track record of building and leading high\-performing presales or solutions teams.
* 7–10 years of overall experience, with significant time spent leading Apple\-focused presales, solutions, or services functions.
* Strong business acumen with experience owning revenue, margin, and growth targets for a practice or business unit.
* Proven leadership skills with the ability to build, mentor, and scale technical teams.
* Ability to develop executive\-level relationships with customers and partners, translating business priorities into technical and commercial solutions.
* Passionate about delivering exceptional customer experience across the presales\-to\-delivery lifecycle.
* Ability to engage confidently with enterprise and CXO\-level stakeholders.
* Demonstrated professionalism in customer and partner interactions, including solution defense and escalation management.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, with the ability to identify issues, obstacles, and opportunities and drive effective solutions.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity, taking a methodical approach to structuring best\-fit solutions.
* Commitment to meeting and exceeding individual, team, and practice\-level KPIs.
* Excellent written, verbal, and executive presentation skills.

**Zones offers a comprehensive Benefits package.**  

  

While we’re committed to providing top\-tier solutions, we’re just as committed to supporting our own teams. We offer a competitive compensation package where our team members are rewarded based on their performance and recognized for the value, they bring into our business. Our team members enjoy a variety of comprehensive benefits, including Medical Insurance Coverage, Group Term Life and Personal Accident Cover to handle the uncertainties of life, flexible leave policy to balance their work life.


At Zones, work is more than a job – it's an exciting career immersed in an inventive, collaborative culture. If you’re interested in working on the cutting edge of IT innovation, sales, engineering, operations, administration, and more, Zones is the place for you!  

  

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or pregnancy.
